我们来玩吧 (Chinese (Simplified)) 准备，好，开始 ...学习游戏背后的科学。 This is a Level 1 book for children who are eager to begin reading. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

pages.originalText: 当我们玩的时候，我们会使用力量。力量：一个推或拉而能帮助我们加快，加慢，停止甚至改变形状。
pages.text:
我们玩耍的时候，会用到力。
力：推或拉物体，可以使物体加速、减速、停止或改变形状。

image.attributionText: Page 8: Two children play on a tyre swing , by Shirish Ghatge © Pratham Books, 2018. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 摩擦力：当其中一个表面试着穿过另一个，并减慢速度。
pages.text: 摩擦力：当两个接触的表面相对运动时，摩擦力通常会阻碍这种运动。

image.attributionText: Page 9: A child slips , by Shirish Ghatge © Pratham Books, 2018. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 精力：给予我们工作与行动的能力。
pages.text: 能量：让物体发生变化或做功的能力。

dimensions.literacy: 我跑/我游泳/我骑自行车等短句规律清楚，可读完马上用动作表达；附页科学词由家长陪读。
